paragraphs.en: As they approached the mountain blocking their path in the Kingdom of Ev, the group found themselves in a dark, silent area. The high peaks on either side blocked out the sunlight, and there were no birds or squirrels to break the stillness. Only bare rocks remained.
paragraphs.zh: 当他们接近阻挡着通往埃夫王国道路的山脉时，一行人发现自己置身于一片阴暗而寂静的地方。两侧高耸的山峰遮挡了阳光，也没有鸟儿或松鼠来打破这份宁静。只剩下光秃秃的岩石。

paragraphs.en: Ozma and Dorothy felt a bit uneasy about the silence, but the others were quiet and serious except for the Sawhorse, which hummed an odd song. As they neared the Nome King's territory, his magnificent underground palace couldn't be far away.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛和多萝西对眼前的沉默感到有些不安，但其他人则保持安静而严肃的态度，只有木马哼着一首奇怪的歌曲。随着他们接近诺姆王的领地，那座宏伟的地底宫殿似乎也不远了。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, they heard jeering laughter. They stopped abruptly as the path ended at a rocky wall. Ozma asked who was laughing, but received no answer.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，他们听到了嘲笑的笑声。当小路在一块岩石墙前戛然而止时，他们立刻停下了脚步。奥兹玛问是谁在笑，但没有得到回答。

paragraphs.en: In the gloom, strange forms flitted across the rock face. These creatures resembled rocks, with colors and rough shapes that suggested they were broken from the mountain.
paragraphs.zh: 在昏暗中，奇怪的影子在岩壁上飘过。这些生物仿佛是岩石的一部分，色彩斑驳，形态粗糙，似乎是从山体断裂而来的。

paragraphs.en: "Do not worry," said Tiktok to Dorothy, who had retreated. "They are Nomes."
paragraphs.zh: “不要担心，”提托克对退缩的多萝西说，“他们就是诺姆人。”

paragraphs.en: "What are Nomes?" asked Dorothy, half frightened.
paragraphs.zh: “诺姆人是什么？”多萝西半是害怕地问道。

paragraphs.en: "They are rock fairies serving the Nome King," replied Tiktok. "But they will do us no harm. You must call for the king; without him, you can never find the palace entrance."
paragraphs.zh: “他们是为诺梅王服务的岩石精灵，”铁皮人回答说，“但他们不会对我们造成伤害。你必须呼唤国王；没有他的许可，你永远找不到宫殿入口。”

paragraphs.en: "YOU call," said Dorothy to Ozma.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西对奥兹玛说道：“你叫喊。”

paragraphs.en: Just then, the Nomes laughed again, and their eerie sound made the twenty-six officers command the private to turn around and run as fast as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 就在这时，诺梅人再次发出一阵令人毛骨悚然的笑声，那声音让那二十六名军官命令士兵掉头并尽可能快地逃跑。

paragraphs.en: The Tin Woodman ordered his army to halt and asked where they were going. A general, trembling in fear, admitted he had forgotten his whisker brush and suggested returning for it. The Tin Woodman explained that passing the giant with the hammer was impossible, as he would kill them all.
paragraphs.zh: 铁皮人命令军队停下，询问他们要去哪里。一个将军战栗着回答说，他忘了带胡须刷，建议回去取一下。铁皮人解释说，他们无法经过那个挥舞锤子的巨人，否则他会把他们都杀掉。

paragraphs.en: "Never!" cried the officers, slapping their chests. A private meekly agreed to obey orders, whether to run or fight.
paragraphs.zh: “绝不行！”军官们拍着胸脯喊道。一名士兵则温顺地同意听从命令，无论是逃跑还是战斗。

paragraphs.en: The Tin Woodman instructed them to return to Ozma and follow her commands. He threatened to demote the officers if they tried to flee again.
paragraphs.zh: 铁皮人命令他们返回奥兹玛那里，并服从她的指令。他威胁说，如果他们再次试图逃跑，就要对他们进行降级处理。

paragraphs.en: Ozma demanded that the Nome King appear before her, but only mocking laughter greeted her from the Nomes on the mountain. Tiktok advised trying an entreaty instead of a command.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛要求 Nome 王出现在她面前，但山上的诺梅们只回应了嘲弄的笑声。提克托克建议尝试恳求而非命令。

paragraphs.en: Ozma asked if she should plead with the wicked Nome King, considering herself their ruler. The group shouted no, insisting they would dig him out if he refused to come. Dorothy volunteered to call the Nome King, as she had more dignity at home than she knew what to do with.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛询问是否应该向邪恶的诺姆王乞求，因为她自认为是他们的统治者。众人齐声反对，坚持要自己挖出诺姆王，除非他愿意现身。多萝西主动提出去叫诺姆王，因为她在家里多得有些不知所措，倒觉得更有尊严一些。

paragraphs.en: The Hungry Tiger threatened, "Do, or I'll eat you for breakfast." Dorothy stepped forward and asked politely, "Mr. Nome King, please come here and see us."
paragraphs.zh: 饥饿的虎鲸威胁道：“要么现在就做，不然我早餐就吃了你。”多萝西上前有礼地问道：“诺梅王先生，请您过来见我们一面好吗？”

paragraphs.en: Laughter from the Nomes stopped abruptly as a low growl echoed from the mountain. The Nomes vanished instantly.
paragraphs.zh: 诺姆国王的笑声突然戛然而止，山中传来一声低沉的咆哮。诺姆们顿时消失无踪。

paragraphs.en: A voice called out, "Enter!" Ozma explained, "We came to rescue Queen Ev and her children, so we must take risks."
paragraphs.zh: 一个声音喊道：“进来！”奥兹玛解释说：“我们来解救埃夫女王和她的孩子们，所以我们必须冒些风险。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok assured them, "The Nome King is honest and good-natured; you can trust him."
paragraphs.zh: 蒂托克向他们保证：“诺梅王为人诚实善良，你可以相信他。”

paragraphs.en: Ozma led Dorothy through a rock door into a long passage lit by jewels. They entered a grand cavern with a throne carved from a rocky boulder. Upon the throne sat the Nome King.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛领着多萝西穿过一块岩石制成的门，进入一条由宝石照明的长廊。她们走进一个宏伟的洞穴，洞中有一块岩石雕琢而成的王座。王座上坐着 Nome 王国的国王。

paragraphs.en: This monarch was a little fat man in gray-brown robes matching his rocky throne. His hair and beard were also rock-colored, as was his face. He wore no crown but a broad belt studded with jewels.
paragraphs.zh: 这位国王是一位身穿灰棕色长袍的矮胖男子，长袍的颜色与他那岩石般的王座相匹配。他的头发和胡须也是岩石般灰色，脸庞也是如此。他没有戴皇冠，只系着一条镶嵌着宝石的宽腰带。

paragraphs.en: His features seemed kindly, and he laughed merrily at Dorothy's comment about him resembling Santa Claus.
paragraphs.zh: 他的面容看起来和善，当多萝西提到他像圣诞老人时，他开心地笑了。

paragraphs.en: "His belly shook like a bowl full of jelly," the Nome King said, laughing. They could see he indeed shook like jelly when he laughed. Both Ozma and Dorothy were relieved to find the Nome King so jolly.
paragraphs.zh: “他的肚子在笑声中摇晃得像装满果冻的碗一样。” Nome 王国国王说道。他们发现他在笑的时候确实像是在摇动果冻，不禁松了一口气。奥兹玛和多萝西见他如此快活，感到非常欣慰。

paragraphs.en: He waved his right hand, signaling them to approach.
paragraphs.zh: 他举起右手，示意他们靠近。

paragraphs.en: The Nome King invited Dorothy and Ozma to sit down. "Tell me why you've come so far and what I can do for you," he said, lighting a pipe with a glowing coal from his pocket.
paragraphs.zh: Nome王请多萝西和奥兹玛坐下。“告诉我，你们为什么长途跋涉来到这里，我能为你们做些什么？”他一边说着，一边从口袋里掏出一颗发光的煤块点燃了他的烟斗。

paragraphs.en: Ozma began speaking. "Your Majesty, I am the ruler of Oz. We have come to ask you to release Queen Ev and her ten children, whom you have enchanted."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛开口说道：“陛下，我是奥兹的统治者。我们前来请求您释放被您施了魔法的伊夫女王和她的十个孩子。”

paragraphs.en: The King denied holding them captive. "They are my slaves, purchased from the King of Ev," he explained.
paragraphs.zh: 国王否认扣留他们为人质。“他们是我的奴隶，是从厄夫国国王那里买来的，”他解释道。

paragraphs.en: "But that was wrong," Dorothy interjected. "The King of Ev did not have a long life; he drowned himself in the sea."
paragraphs.zh: “但这不对，”多萝西插话说道，“埃夫国的国王并没有长寿；他是在海里淹死的。”

paragraphs.en: The Nome King smiled contentedly. "I gave him a long life, but he destroyed it by jumping into the sea." He continued, "If I gave you a doll and you smashed it, would you expect me to return it?"
paragraphs.zh: Nome王满意地笑了笑：“我给了他长久的生命，但他却因跳入海中而毁了这一切。”他又说道：“如果你得到了一个洋娃娃然后把它摔碎了，你还会指望我再给你一个新的吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No," Dorothy replied.
paragraphs.zh: “不,”多萝西回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Exactly," the King said. "Similarly, I cannot give up Queen Ev's family because their king destroyed his own long life."
paragraphs.zh: “正是如此，”国王说道，“同样地，我不能放弃埃夫女王的家族，因为他们的国王毁掉了自己长久的生命。”

paragraphs.en: Ozma was distressed by this. "But you are treating them cruelly by making them your slaves."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛对此感到忧虑：“但你这样让他们成为你的奴隶未免太过残忍了。”

paragraphs.en: The King puffed smoke and asked, "In what way is that cruel?"
paragraphs.zh: 国王喷出烟雾，问道：“那究竟有什么残忍之处？”

paragraphs.en: The Nome King watched them float into the air, declaring, "I cannot abide such frivolity." He transformed Queen Ev and her children into ornaments, scattering them throughout his palace. "They now merely decorate my apartments," he said, "and I consider this a kind gesture."
paragraphs.zh: Nome王看着他们飘向空中，喊道：“我无法忍受这种轻浮。”他将女王伊夫及其孩子们变成了装饰品，散落在他的宫殿各处。“如今他们仅仅用来装饰我的寝宫，”他说，“我认为这算是一种善意的表现。”

paragraphs.en: Ozma protested, "What a terrible fate for them! The Kingdom of Ev needs its royal family to govern it. Release them and restore their forms, and I will give you ten ornaments in return."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛抗议道：“这可是多么可怕的命运啊！埃夫王国需要它的王室来治理。释放他们并恢复他们的原形，我愿意给你十件装饰品作为回报。”

paragraphs.en: The Nome King appeared serious but then laughed until he choked, turning his face from grayish-brown to bright red. He wiped his eyes with a rock-colored handkerchief before becoming grave again.
paragraphs.zh: Nome王起初显得神情严肃，随后却笑得喘不过气来，脸从灰褐色变成了鲜红色。他用一块岩石般颜色的手帕擦了擦眼睛，随即又恢复了庄重的神情。

paragraphs.en: "You are brave and beautiful," he said to Ozma, "but you underestimate the task ahead." He led her to a door, opening it to reveal a balcony overlooking the Underground World. A vast cave extended under the mountain, filled with glowing furnaces and Nomes hammering precious metals or polishing jewels.
paragraphs.zh: 他对奥兹玛说：“你勇敢又美丽，但你低估了前方的任务。”随后领她来到一扇门前，推开大门，露出了一个俯瞰地下世界的阳台。山下延伸着一个巨大的洞穴，里面布满了发光的熔炉，诺姆人正锤炼珍贵金属或打磨宝石。

paragraphs.en: Thousands of silver and gold doors lined the walls.
paragraphs.zh: 成千上万扇银光闪闪和金光灿灿的门排列在墙壁上。

paragraphs.en: Ozma gazed in wonder as the Nome King whistled sharply. Instantly, ranks of rock-colored soldiers emerged from every door, filling the cavern and forcing workmen to stop their tasks. Despite their squat and fat forms, they wore gleaming steel armor adorned with gems, each wearing a brilliant electric light on his brow.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛惊奇地望着 Nome 王王后吹了一声口哨。顿时，一排排岩石色的士兵从每个门口涌现出来，填满了洞穴，迫使工人们停下手中的工作。尽管这些士兵矮胖敦实，但他们身着闪亮的钢制铠甲，上面镶嵌着宝石，每个人的额头上都戴着一枚耀眼的电灯。

paragraphs.en: The Nome King displayed his army, a well-trained force of bronze battle-axes. He boasted that no ruler had ever dared to challenge him and never would. With a whistle, his soldiers vanished through golden doorways.
paragraphs.zh: Nome王展示了他那支训练有素的青铜战斧军队。他得意洋洋地宣称，没有任何统治者曾胆敢挑战他，将来也不会有人敢于挑战。随着一声哨响，他的士兵们消失在金色的大门之后。

paragraphs.en: Sad and discouraged, Ozma turned to her friends. The Nome King calmly resumed his seat on the rock throne.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛伤心又沮丧地转向她的朋友们。 Nome王平静地重新在岩石王座上坐了下来。

paragraphs.en: "It's foolish to fight," said Ozma to the Tin Woodman. "Our brave Twenty-Seven would be destroyed quickly."
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛对青铜木人说道：“与其战斗，倒是一件愚蠢的事。我们的勇士第廿七号很快就会被摧毁。”

paragraphs.en: The Tiger suggested asking about the kitchen, as he was hungry. The Cowardly Lion proposed pouncing on the King but failed to approach the throne.
paragraphs.zh: 老虎提议先问问厨房的情况，因为他饿了。胆小的狮子则建议直接扑向王座，但未能靠近宝座。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow suggested wheedling the King into freeing the slaves. The Nome King agreed, stating that coaxing was more effective than threats.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人建议用软磨硬泡的方法让国王释放奴隶。 Nome王同意了，他说哄骗比威胁更有效。

paragraphs.en: Ozma decided to befriend the King and discuss liberating Queen Ev and her children. She asked if she could take risks to free them.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛决定与国王结交，讨论解救女王伊夫及其子女的事宜。她问国王是否可以冒些风险去把她们救出来。

paragraphs.en: "Yes," replied Ozma eagerly.
paragraphs.zh: “是的,”奥兹玛急切地回答道。

paragraphs.en: The Nome King offered a deal: Ozma would go into his palace to rescue the captives, with some risks involved.
paragraphs.zh: Nome王提出了一项交易：奥兹玛可以进入他的宫殿营救被俘的同伴，但过程中存在一定风险。

paragraphs.en: Ozma eagerly thanked the Nome King for his offer. He proposed that she examine eleven objects in his palace, saying "Ev" each time. If any of these turned out to be transformed members of the royal family of Ev or her children, they would be restored to their true forms and leave with Ozma.
paragraphs.zh: 奥兹玛感激地向 Nome 王国的国王表示感谢。他提议让她在宫殿里检查十一件物品，每次说“Ev”。如果其中有任何一件被证实是埃夫王国或其子民的变形成员，他们将恢复原状，并随奥兹玛一起离开。

paragraphs.en: However, if none were correct, Ozma herself would become enchanted and transformed into a decorative item.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，如果没有人说得对，奥兹玛自己也会被施以魔法，变成一件装饰品。

paragraphs.en: The Nome King added one condition: "If you do not guess all eleven correctly," he said, his eyes twinkling, "you will instead be enchanted and turned into an ornament." This was fair, as it matched the risk Ozma had agreed to take.
paragraphs.zh: Nome王又加了一个条件：“如果你们不能全部猜对十一项，”他眼睛闪烁着说道，“你们将会被施以魔法，变成一件装饰品。”这倒是公平的，因为这与奥兹玛同意承担的风险相符。
